en.headline: Reports say police arrest man, 66, over Sau Mau Ping paint attack
en.dek: Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao, citing sources, say a 66-year-old estate resident was held over red paint thrown at two lawmakers' joint office.
body: Police have arrested a 66-year-old man over the red-paint attack on a joint district office in Sau Mau Ping Estate, according to Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao, both citing sources. The office, used by lawmakers Tang Ka-piu and Chan Pui-leung, was reported damaged at about 6:40am on Thursday.

The reports said the man is a resident of the estate. Sources told the outlets he was recorded on closed-circuit television wearing a helmet and throwing red paint at the office at about 3am, then returning to a flat in the estate. They said he admitted the act and told officers he was unhappy that a complaint of his had not been followed up. The case is being treated as criminal damage and handled by the Sau Mau Ping district crime unit.

Radio Television Hong Kong reported earlier on Thursday that no one had been arrested after the morning report. The later accounts of an arrest have not been set out in an official police statement seen by this desk.

Tang told Sing Tao he did not understand the attack. He said the office had held a community carnival in the estate on Sunday without incident, and that earlier damage to the office, including a broken lock and objects thrown at it, had been more minor. He said staff safety was his main concern and that the matter was with the police.

zh.headline: 消息指秀茂坪淋紅油案 警方拘捕66歲男子
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島引述消息稱，一名66歲邨內居民涉向兩名議員聯合辦事處淋紅油，已被拘捕，案件列刑事毀壞。
body: 秀茂坪邨兩名立法會議員聯合辦事處遭淋紅油一案，據《香港01》及星島引述消息，警方已拘捕一名66歲男子。事發辦事處位於秀緻樓地下，由鄧家彪及陳沛良使用，警方今早約6時40分接獲保安報案。
兩份報道指，被捕男子是邨內居民。消息稱，閉路電視顯示他凌晨約3時戴頭盔向辦事處淋紅油，其後返回邨內住所。消息又稱，他承認淋油，並表示不滿議員未跟進其投訴。案件列作刑事毀壞，由秀茂坪警區刑事調查隊跟進。
港台今早較早報道指，初步調查後暫未有人被捕。上述拘捕消息目前未見警方公開聲明確認。
鄧家彪接受星島查詢時表示，對辦事處被破壞不明所以。他說辦事處周日才在邨內辦社區嘉年華，當時未見異樣；以往曾有門鎖被破壞或遭擲雜物，但今次屬較明顯的破壞。他最關心員工安全，事件交由警方跟進。
